verdict.rationale: Capacities' first-party docs describe block-based linking: you can link to individual blocks inside an object and reference them in other pages. They also state that an embedded block is identical to the original, so edits appear everywhere it is used, which covers both transclusion and staying in sync. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of block references or embedding, and no evidence on referencing whole sections or heading ranges as opposed to single blocks.
